triage_summary: Todo constructor accepts empty/whitespace-only text while rename() method rejects them. Fixed by adding validation in __post_init__.
root_cause: Missing text validation in Todo.__post_init__() - only timestamp initialization was handled
fix_approach: Add validation at the beginning of __post_init__ to check for empty or whitespace-only text, matching rename() behavior
risks: Code that directly instantiates Todo with empty text will now raise ValueError
from_dict() will also reject empty text which may affect deserialization of existing invalid data
